title: 1 Clonskeagh Road, Ranelagh, Dublin 6, D06N4T2
description:
A high-quality multi-unit residential asset in a well-established and highly desirable Dublin 6 location.

1 Clonskeagh Road presents a high-quality residential investment opportunity comprising a fully refurbished multi-unit apartment building in one of South Dublin's most affluent and established residential locations. Extending to approximately 373 sq. m (4,015 sq. ft), the property offers an attractive blend of income, quality and long-term asset management appeal.

The property comprises a red-brick building arranged over three levels laid out in ten self-contained residential units. The accommodation includes seven one-bedroom apartments, two two-bedroom apartments, and one studio, providing a diverse mix of accommodation designed to appeal to a broad tenant base. Units are all substantially energy efficient, all of A and B BER rating.

The building has recently been comprehensively refurbished and upgraded to a high standard throughout, delivering a modern, sustainable and low-maintenance investment proposition. The property benefits from a comprehensive suite of compliance documentation and is fully compliant with planning, fire safety and local authority housing requirements. The asset is complemented by low operating expenditure and is managed by a leading Dublin-based asset manager specialising in reporting, administration and operational services for global investors, further enhancing its appeal as a hands-off investment opportunity.

The apartments are arranged around central communal circulation areas and provide bright, well-proportioned living accommodation. Externally, the property is set behind a traditional front garden enclosed by attractive cast-iron railings, while a generous paved rear yard provides two designated car parking spaces.

1 Clonskeagh Road enjoys a prime South Dublin location at the junction of Clonskeagh Road and Donnybrook Road, offering excellent connectivity to Dublin City Centre, Donnybrook, Ballsbridge and Ranelagh. The area benefits from a wide range of amenities, including cafés, restaurants, shops, fitness facilities and parks, creating an attractive environment for tenants.

Conveniently located close to UCD and St. Vincent's University Hospital, the property also enjoys excellent access to the N11, M50 motorway network and Dublin Airport. The Luas Green Line at nearby Milltown and Ranelagh provides fast and convenient access to the city centre and surrounding suburbs, while a variety of Dublin Bus services further enhance connectivity. Together, these attributes make 1 Clonskeagh Road an exceptionally accessible and well-connected location.

1 Clonskeagh Road offers investors the opportunity to acquire a substantial, turnkey residential asset in a proven and resilient rental market, supported by strong long-term demographic, economic and occupational demand drivers.

Fully Let, Tenants Unaffected.
